name: encoding.base32
doc:
encoding.base32: RFC 4648 base32 (Go's encoding/base32). Encode /
Decode use the standard alphabet with padding, like encoding.base64;
EncodeHex / DecodeHex the "extended hex" alphabet; NewEncoding makes
others, with or without padding.

items.name: Decode
items.doc: Decode decodes s with the standard alphabet.
items.summary: Decode decodes s with the standard alphabet.

items.name: DecodeHex
items.doc: DecodeHex decodes s with the extended hex alphabet.
items.summary: DecodeHex decodes s with the extended hex alphabet.

items.name: DecodeString
items.doc: DecodeString decodes s with the standard alphabet into a string.
items.summary: DecodeString decodes s with the standard alphabet into a string.

items.name: Encode
items.doc: Encode encodes src with the standard alphabet.
items.summary: Encode encodes src with the standard alphabet.

items.name: EncodeHex
items.doc: EncodeHex encodes src with the extended hex alphabet.
items.summary: EncodeHex encodes src with the extended hex alphabet.

items.name: EncodeString
items.doc: EncodeString encodes the bytes of s with the standard alphabet.
items.summary: EncodeString encodes the bytes of s with the standard alphabet.

items.name: NewEncoding
items.doc: An encoding with the given 32-character alphabet, padded.
items.summary: An encoding with the given 32-character alphabet, padded.

items.name: Encoding
items.doc: An alphabet of 32 distinct ASCII characters and a padding choice.
items.summary: An alphabet of 32 distinct ASCII characters and a padding choice.

members.name: WithPadding
members.doc: The same alphabet with (true) or without (false) '=' padding.
members.summary: The same alphabet with (true) or without (false) '=' padding.

members.name: Encode
members.doc: Encode returns the base32 encoding of src.
members.summary: Encode returns the base32 encoding of src.

members.name: EncodeString
members.doc: EncodeString returns the base32 encoding of the bytes of s.
members.summary: EncodeString returns the base32 encoding of the bytes of s.

members.name: Decode
members.doc:
Decodes s; padding is required iff the encoding pads. Line breaks
(\r, \n) are ignored, as in Go.
members.summary: Decodes s; padding is required iff the encoding pads.

members.name: DecodeString
members.doc: DecodeString decodes s into a string.
members.summary: DecodeString decodes s into a string.
